transcript:
Meeting header
Date: 2026-03-14
Time: 10:00 UTC
Duration: 38 minutes
Attendees: Sergio Alvarez (Redwood), Connor O'Brien (Redwood), Priya Menon (BetaAI), Alex Nguyen (BetaAI)

Summary (auto)
- Discussed ongoing pilot usage and reliability
- BetaAI raised concern about streaming responses ending early

Transcript
[00:00] Sergio Alvarez: Hey all, quick weekly check-in. Anything blocking you this week?
[00:10] Priya Menon: Uh yeah, one thing. Streaming is a little flaky for us. Not always, but sometimes it just like, stops mid-response.
[00:25] Connor O'Brien: When you say stops, do you get an error or does it just end?
[00:30] Priya Menon: Sometimes we see a socket hang up. Other times the callback just stops and we never get the final done message.
[00:45] Sergio Alvarez: Got it. Is this on the OpenAI compatible endpoint?
[00:48] Priya Menon: Yes. Chat completions, streaming true.
[01:05] Connor O'Brien: Ok. Weve seen a few reports that sound similar. Can you send request IDs + rough times?
[01:15] Priya Menon: Yeah. Its not super frequent but enough that PM is noticing.
[01:30] Alex Nguyen: Its like the stream ends halfway through a sentence, so we display partial text and then it freezes.
[02:00] Sergio Alvarez: Understood. Well investigate on our side and come back with an ETA and a recommended retry strategy.
[03:10] Connor O'Brien: For now, Id suggest treating unexpected end-of-stream as retryable, but well confirm the best approach.
[36:50] Sergio Alvarez: Cool. Next steps: well dig into logs and update you, and you send us the request ids.
